runtime_needed: Read clear_box as a strict prefab-axis size in metres; never use the old x1.25 +0.02 allowance.
Keep original native-scale type allocation and per-item rotated bottom placement. Long cells also accept OneHandedWeapon so spears can route there.
No type-ignoring fallback into unrelated bow or shield cells.
These are asset/mirror checks, not in-game runtime integration.
clear_box_contract: clear_box is [width,height,depth] in prefab Unity axes, bottom-centred on bottom_position_unity. Strict rotated native bounds <= clear_box; no 1.25 factor and no 2cm allowance. Cell domain caps open-top height.
